critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED by test agent: /api/admin/super/grant-bonus returned HTTP 422 'Field required loc=[query, req]' because the Pydantic BonusReq class was defined inside the closure _attach_admin(). FastAPI + Pydantic v2 fail to recognize closure-scoped BaseModel subclasses as request-body schemas and fall back to treating the param as a query field. Fix applied: hoisted BonusReq to module scope in /app/backend/super_app.py (alongside CancelReq). Verified: endpoint now returns 200 with correct {success, user_id, points, cashback} response, and demo user's reward_points + wallet.balance update atomically. Recommend keeping all Pydantic request models at module scope as a project convention.
super_app.py is 250 lines — clean and within limits. All endpoints validate input with Pydantic and excluding _id projections everywhere (good).
Cancellation refund policy correctly differentiates 90% (>=24h) vs 50% (<24h) using travel_date parsing with safe fallback to now()+7d on parse failure — robust.

award_cashback() is idempotent on a per-transaction basis and atomically updates user.reward_points + wallet.balance + transactions collection — good design. Travel/insurance 2× points multiplier is applied correctly.
/insurance/quote uses pure-formula demo calculations with proper GST (18%), monthly_emi, and per-plan-type breakdowns — sensible defaults and returns mode='demo' for transparency.

/insurance/compare returns 404 cleanly when no IDs match seed (verified). Could be enhanced to read INSURANCE_PLANS directly instead of going through _db.insurance_seed, but current path works once seed runs at startup.
/admin/super/* endpoints correctly enforce role check via _ensure(admin) → 403 for unauthorized roles. Tested with super_admin role only — other roles not verified but logic is straightforward.

Frontend testIDs cover all interactive elements: travel-tab-bus/train, book-bus-*, book-train-*, cancel-booking-*, calc-age, calc-cover, calc-quote-btn, redeem-points-btn, reward-points — excellent testability.

Backend bug pattern to watch: any Pydantic BaseModel used as request body MUST be defined at module scope (not inside attach()/closures) — otherwise FastAPI 2.x treats it as query params and returns 422.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — /api/admin/super/grant-bonus 422 error: BonusReq pydantic model was declared inside _attach_admin() closure. FastAPI's parameter-classification logic in fastapi.dependencies.utils.analyze_param() inspects type annotations via inspect.signature() at route-registration time; when the annotation refers to a class defined inside the same lexical scope as the route handler, Pydantic v2 BaseModel detection sometimes fails (the class object is valid but FastAPI's lenient_issubclass check on the inferred FieldInfo's annotation can mis-classify it as a primitive param). Result: req gets categorized as query param → JSON body is ignored → 'Field required at query.req'. REPRO: POST /api/admin/super/grant-bonus with body {user_id, points, cashback} and admin Bearer → 422. MITIGATION: hoisted BonusReq to module scope alongside CancelReq/QuoteReq (which already work). Verified fix via pytest TestAdminSuper::test_grant_bonus PASSED — demo user's reward_points incremented by 50 and wallet.balance by ₹10.
